description: This Java source file defines a REST API resource for managing Tax Components in the Fineract platform. It includes endpoints to list, retrieve, create, and update tax components, integrating security, serialization, and command handling.

classes.name: TaxComponentApiResource
classes.description: REST API resource class for managing Tax Components, supporting listing, retrieval, creation, and updating operations.

methods.name: retrieveAllTaxComponents
methods.description: Handles GET request to list all tax components.

methods.name: retrieveTaxComponent
methods.description: Handles GET request to retrieve details of a specific tax component by ID.

methods.name: retrieveTemplate
methods.description: Handles GET request to retrieve a template for creating a new tax component.

methods.name: createTaxComponent
methods.description: Handles POST request to create a new tax component, serializing the request and logging the command.

methods.name: updateTaxCompoent
methods.description: Handles PUT request to update an existing tax component by ID, serializing the request.
